foundationGates.gate: Accepted shared authority and deployment foundations, not just a nominal WP-31 completion flag
foundationGates.finding: WP-31 explicitly depends on WP-08, WP-03, WP-04, WP-12 and WP-52. WP-32 further requires canonical entity FKs, authenticated principals, resource actions, receipts/outbox and consumer leases. The inspected local handlers use caller arguments and local journals, not evidence of these shared foundations.
foundationGates.requiredBeforeImplementation: Lead supplies accepted WP-31 interfaces covering canonical call/room mapping, principal identity, policy epoch/revoke fencing, command transaction/outbox, provider receipts and selected database/migrator. These are transitive/interface prerequisites; do not add them to WP-32's explicit dependencies array. WP-02 registry and WP-01 identity are published foundational mechanisms, not newly invented WP-32 edges.

foundationGates.gate: Real SFU readiness, exact license audit, provider room control and TURN/capture capabilities
foundationGates.finding: ROOM_PROVIDER_DECISION has null provider/license and decided=false; joinRoom always returns failure. Room minting alone cannot eject an already connected guest. Local capture is not screen sharing.
foundationGates.requiredBeforeImplementation: Accepted WP-31 LiveKit adapter/token API, server-side removal and reconciliation operations, isolated provider sandbox/credentials via secret adapter, verified TURN/network and actual remote media/capture surface. Do not flip capability to true or infer live readiness from installed SDKs.

foundationGates.finding: Package forbids Macro channel guests and requires a named ROX decision, whereas CALL-01 describes G joining a channel call. These cannot be satisfied by accidental reuse of existing meeting links.
foundationGates.requiredBeforeImplementation: Lead records scope/action/inheritance decision for ROX channel guests and reconciles CALL-01 fixtures. Until accepted, channel guest invite/join fails guests_disallowed; positive guest-room acceptance must still be exercised in an explicitly permitted call scope.

foundationGates.gate: Invite contract reconciliation and secure retry semantics
foundationGates.finding: Wire command uses call/expiresAt/allowedActions in RoxCommand v2; domain API uses callRef/expiresAt/allowedMedia/idempotencyKey and returns inviteId/bearerUrl. allowedActions has only arbitrary string schema, not a validated MediaPermission vocabulary. Hashed-token-only persistence conflicts with naive raw bearer URL storage in an idempotent command receipt.
foundationGates.requiredBeforeImplementation: Accepted single typed mapping of wire and domain DTOs, bounded valid future expiry, action vocabulary with microphone/camera/screen publication separately authorized, revision policy, typed result/error mapping and secure one-time/recovery delivery semantics. Keep raw bearer material out of database rows, receipts, outbox and logs; do not weaken restart/idempotency acceptance.

foundationGates.finding: Existing callbackReplay boolean is caller input, not signed webhook validation. Published HandleLivekitEvent input names signedBody/deliveryId but does not specify transport authorization signature metadata, provider ordering or reconnect session correlation.
foundationGates.requiredBeforeImplementation: Accepted provider signature verifier on exact raw bytes and authorization metadata, key source and replay policy, canonical room lookup, delivery dedup and joinSession/provider-session mapping with bounded delayed-exit semantics. Signature failure must happen before any participant, receipt or outbox mutation.

risks: Active ejection cannot be replaced by a short token TTL; provider failure after revocation needs durable reconciliation and truthful pending fence.
Array-based MeetingShareRecord members/links could accidentally grant guest archive/search/private-note access if reused as guest identity or ACL.
Current ROOM_JOIN ignores transport actor/workspace and forces recording consent; copying it to the shared path would breach authority and consent.
Guest raw URL replay/idempotency recovery must not persist bearer material in command receipts; token hash alone is not a complete safe response-delivery design.
Delayed leave or duplicated provider event can terminate a reconnected participant unless tied to exact joinSession and fenced ordering.
Screen video plus optional screen audio must both stop/unpublish on every lifecycle exit; unmount/OS stop/reconnect paths can leak active capture or duplicate tracks.
Current room tests cannot verify unauthorized/replayed callbacks because provider undecided short-circuits; passing these existing tests would not prove WP-32.
CALL-01 generic channel guest fixture and explicit channel prohibition need a named policy resolution, not a silent acceptance reduction.
Shared calls files overlap WP-31; migration identifiers overlap semantic schema work. One owner/selected migrator is required to avoid duplicate stores/tables and lost integration changes.
Whole-file hashes are inspection-snapshot evidence only; root-owned integration can stale them. This report does not assert clean Git state or feature completion.
